sources.title: OpenTelemetry .NET documentation
sources.finding: OpenTelemetry .NET supports stable traces, metrics, and logs for currently supported .NET versions.

sources.title: OpenTelemetry .NET log correlation
sources.finding: Logs produced within an active Activity are automatically correlated through TraceId, SpanId, and TraceFlags.

sources.title: .NET observability with OpenTelemetry
sources.finding: The .NET platform supplies ILogger, Meter, and ActivitySource APIs; OpenTelemetry collects and exports them through vendor-neutral OTLP or backend adapters.

sources.title: OpenTelemetry Protocol exporter for .NET
sources.finding: The OTLP exporter accepts an endpoint capable of receiving OTLP. Stable OpenTelemetry 1.19.1 package releases were available at review time for .NET 8 and later.

sources.title: Grafana Docker OpenTelemetry LGTM
sources.finding: The local Grafana OTEL-LGTM reference stack is suitable for development, demo, and testing; ADR-0009 preserves backend-neutral application instrumentation.

decision: Use OpenTelemetry/OTLP conventions and a local Grafana OTEL-LGTM development/test endpoint. Keep application instrumentation backend-neutral, derive correlation from platform Activity context, and enforce a restrictive telemetry redaction boundary before export.
limitations: No Product/business metric, usage or billing metering, production provider selection, production deployment, credential, or application host behavior is authorized.
Package versions and source freshness must be rechecked before any material provider, runtime, or production scope change.
